Groups.title: Your Quran circles
Groups.description: Create a private group for your family, friends, or students. Weekly assignments will live here next.
Groups.emptyDescription: Create a group to organize learners, or join one using an invitation code.

create.title: Create a group
create.description: You will become its first admin and receive a private invitation code.
create.name: Group name
create.error: We couldn’t create the group. Please try again.

join.title: Join a group
join.description: Enter the invitation code shared with you by a group admin.
join.notFound: That invitation code is not valid.
join.error: We couldn’t join the group. Please try again.

detail.memberDescription: Admins can manage access now. Member assignments will be added in the next stage.
detail.inviteDescription: Share this private link or code with someone you want to add.
detail.adminOnly: Only group admins can see the invitation code.
detail.confirmRemove: Remove this person from the group?
detail.confirmLeave: Leave this group? You will need a new invitation to return.
detail.confirmDelete: Delete this group permanently? This cannot be undone.
detail.lastAdmin: Choose another admin before removing or changing the final admin.
detail.meetingHost: Choose another meeting host before changing or removing this admin.
detail.failed: We couldn’t update the group. Please try again.

assignments.title: Member assignments
assignments.description: Give each learner their own memorization or revision range. Ranges may continue across surahs.
assignments.emptyDescriptionAdmin: Create the first assignment for a member of this group.
assignments.emptyDescriptionMember: Your group admin has not assigned you a range yet.
assignments.createDescription: The range will use the selected learner’s riwayah and Quran numbering.
assignments.searchMember: Type a member’s name or email…
assignments.dueMeetingHint: The unfinished reminder will be sent 24 hours before this meeting.
assignments.noUpcomingMeetings: Add an upcoming group meeting before assigning work.
assignments.instructionsPlaceholder: Add a short note for this learner…
assignments.success: The assignment has been given to this learner.
assignments.error: We couldn’t create this assignment. Check the selected range and try again.
assignments.currentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No current assignments} one {# current assignment} other {# current assignments}}
assignments.readyCount: {count, plural, one {# ready for review} other {# ready for review}}

progress.title: Progress at a glance
progress.compactAbsenceStreak: {count, plural, one {# unexcused absence} other {# consecutive unexcused absences}}
progress.awaitingReview: {count, plural, one {# awaiting review} other {# awaiting review}}
progress.excusedAbsences: {count, plural, one {# excused absence} other {# excused absences}}

assignments.noCurrentForMember: This member has no current assignment.
assignments.deleteConfirm: Delete this member assignment? Their saved progress for it will also be removed.

planner.title: Prepare everyone’s week
planner.description: Set one deadline, prepare a focused range for every member, and publish the assignments together when the plan is ready.
planner.copied: The previous week has been copied. Adjust the ranges before publishing.
planner.plannedCount: {count, plural, one {# member planned} other {# members planned}}
planner.missingCount: {count, plural, one {# member still missing} other {# members still missing}}
planner.publishHintMissing: Prepare an assignment for the remaining {count, plural, one {member} other {members}} before publishing.
planner.publishHintReady: The plan is complete. Publishing will make every assignment visible to its member.
planner.selectOne: Add at least one member before saving this draft.
planner.completeEveryMember: Every member needs an assignment before the week can be published.
planner.draftSaved: The weekly plan draft has been saved.
planner.published: The week has been published to all members.
planner.saveError: We couldn’t save this weekly plan. Check the ranges and try again.

review.title: Review {name}’s assignment
review.description: Use the Quran text while listening, then record the outcome of this review.
review.decisionDescription: Your decision determines what the learner sees next.
review.notePlaceholder: Add a short, practical note for the learner…
review.revisionHint: Returning the assignment resets its saved checkpoint so the learner can make a fresh pass through the range.
review.revisionSuccess: The assignment was returned for more work.
review.error: We couldn’t save this review. The assignment may already have been reviewed.
review.notReadyTitle: This assignment is not waiting for review
review.notReadyDescription: The learner may still be working on it, or another admin has already reviewed it.

dashboard.title: Learn and revise together
dashboard.emptyDescription: Create a group for family, friends, or students and prepare for shared weekly assignments.
dashboard.activeDescription: You belong to {count, plural, one {# memorization group} other {# memorization groups}}.
dashboard.meetingNowDescription: Your circle’s meeting room is ready to join.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.description: The latest assignments, submissions, and completed meetings in this circle.
activity.empty: Group activity will appear here as your circle begins working together.
activity.submissionSelf: You submitted an assignment for review.
activity.meeting: A group meeting ended with {count, plural, =0 {no attendees} one {# attendee} other {# attendees}}.

meeting.setupDescriptionAdmin: Add the days and times when your circle meets. The room will open for three hours at each scheduled time.
meeting.setupDescriptionMember: A group admin has not scheduled the meeting yet.
meeting.liveTitle: Your Quran circle is meeting now
meeting.closesIn: The room remains open for {hours, plural, =0 {} one {# hour } other {# hours }}{minutes, plural, =0 {} one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
meeting.hostedBy: Hosted by {name}. Members enter once the host starts the meeting.
meeting.scheduleDescription: Add every day and time when this circle normally meets.
meeting.timezoneHint: Times will stay fixed in this timezone, including when daylight-saving rules change.
meeting.saved: The meeting schedule has been saved.
meeting.saveError: We couldn’t save this schedule. Check the times and timezone.

history.title: Meeting history
history.descriptionAdmin: Review attendance and decide whether each absence is accepted. Three consecutive unaccepted absences remove an ordinary member.
history.descriptionMember: Review your attendance and absence decisions from previous circle meetings.
history.empty: Meetings will appear here after their attendance window closes.
history.notAttended: You did not attend this meeting.
history.reviewSaved: The absence decision has been saved.
history.reviewError: We couldn’t save this absence decision.
history.memberRemoved: The third consecutive unaccepted absence was recorded, and the member was removed.

room.loadError: The meeting room couldn’t be loaded.
room.waitingDescription: You’ll enter automatically as soon as {name} starts the meeting.
